0022600100.text: The Utah Jazz, 0-1 and 5th in the Northwest, host the New Orleans Pelicans, also 0-1 and 3rd in the Southwest, in the Jazz's second game of the 2026-27 season. Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic, who is out with a foot injury, while Tony Bradley (quadriceps) and Trey Alexander (knee) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have no meetings yet in 2026-27, after the Jazz lost 0-3 to New Orleans in the 2025-26 season series, including a 156-137 loss in New Orleans on April 7, 2026.
